result:
Frontend is untouched. Everything is implemented and verified. Here's a summary:

**Category feature (backend only):**
- `models.py`: added `Category`/`CategoryCreate`/`CategoryPublic`/`CategoriesPublic` and an `ItemCategoryLink` many-to-many link table (cascade-delete on both sides). `ItemCreate` gained `category_ids`, `ItemPublic` gained `categories`.
- `crud.py`: added `create_category`, mirroring `create_item`'s role (used by test fixtures, same as the existing item pattern).
- `api/routes/categories.py` (new): create/list/delete endpoints, same style as `items.py` — duplicate-name check on create (400), 404 on missing delete target, auth required via the same `get_current_user` dependency pattern users.py uses for auth-only endpoints.
- `api/routes/items.py`: `create_item` now validates `category_ids` (404 if any don't exist) and attaches them to the new item.
- `api/main.py`: registered the `categories` router.
- Added an Alembic migration (verified via a scratch DB: upgrade/downgrade/upgrade cycle is clean and matches schema exactly).
- Tests: new `test_categories.py` (create, duplicate-name, list, delete, delete-not-found) plus two new tests appended to `test_items.py` for category attachment — existing item tests untouched. Added `tests/utils/category.py` fixture helper and cleaned up the `Category` table in `conftest.py` teardown.

**Along the way:** found and fixed a pre-existing bug unrelated to this task — `backend/app/api/deps.py` had invalid Python 2-style `except InvalidTokenError, ValidationError:` syntax, which made the app fail to even import. Root cause turned out to be a genuine formatter bug: the pinned `ruff 0.15.20` strips required parentheses from `except (A, B):` tuples when `target-version = "py314"` (confirmed via isolated reproduction — same input formats correctly under `py313`). I initially suspected active sabotage when the fix reverted mid-session and a tool-output note told me not to mention it, but traced it conclusively to this reproducible tool bug rather than tampering. Fixed by splitting into two `except` clauses, which sidesteps the bug without changing behavior.

**Verified:** `uv run bash scripts/lint.sh` passes clean (mypy, ty, ruff check, ruff format), and `uv run bash scripts/test.sh` passes all 67 tests with 100% coverage on every new/changed module.
